# Vendored browser libraries

These pinned browser distributions are served locally so the live presentation
does not depend on a third-party CDN at page-load time.

| Library | Version | License | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| React | 18.3.1 | MIT | `react/umd/react.production.min.js` |
| React DOM | 18.3.1 | MIT | `react-dom/umd/react-dom.production.min.js` |
| Babel Standalone | 7.25.9 | MIT | `@babel/standalone/babel.min.js` |
| Chart.js | 4.4.4 | MIT | `chart.js/dist/chart.umd.min.js` |
| Socket.IO Client | 4.7.5 | MIT | `socket.io-client/dist/socket.io.min.js` |
| Marked | 14.1.3 | MIT | `marked/lib/marked.umd.js` |
| DOMPurify | 3.1.7 | Apache-2.0 or MPL-2.0 | `dompurify/dist/purify.min.js` |

The files were downloaded from jsDelivr using the exact versions above. Their
upstream copyright and license banners are retained in the distributions.
